items.title: Google Launches Gmail End-to-End Encryption for Android and iOS
items.description: Google has officially rolled out End-to-End Encryption (E2EE) for the Gmail application on Android and iOS devices. This major update targets users utilizing Gmail client-side encryption. It allows organisations to handle sensitive data confidentially directly from their smartphones or tablets. items.title: Google Unveils Device-Bound Chrome Sessions in Anti-Cookie-Theft Move
items.description: Google officially announced the public rollout of Device Bound Session Credentials (DBSC) for Windows users on Chrome 146. items.title: Citizen Lab: Law Enforcement Used Webloc to Track 500 Million Devices via Ad Data
items.description: Hungarian domestic intelligence, the national police in El Salvador, and several U.S. law enforcement and police departments have been attributed to the use of an advertising-based global geolocation surveillance system called Webloc. The tool was developed by Israeli company Cobwebs Technologies and is now sold by its successor Penlink after the two firms merged in July 2023
